_comment: Sweep-6 — follow-up to sweep-5: re-centred bg_var_threshold on the sweep-5 plateau (16-64) at finer resolution plus one tail-risk sentinel (80), shifted bg_history's window upward (2000-6000, was still improving at the sweep-5 ceiling), dropped gaussian_kernel_size from the active sweep (fixed at 3 in the base pipeline — weak, consistently unfavourable), and extended gaussian_sigma_x past the sweep-5 ceiling (1.0-3.0) since higher values are now trending better, contradicting the sweep-4 hand-picked pipeline's sigma_x=0.8. base_pipeline is pipe-v4-base-sweep6.json (= pipe-v3-base-sweep5.json with gaussian_kernel_size fixed 3). See param_ranges_sweep6.json for full rationale per param. IMPORTANT: fix the analyse.py df_agg aggregation bug (see param_ranges_sweep6.json note) before relying on 03_cluster_overview.png from this run — it currently drops all sweep-5/6 params and only carries the stale sweep-4 param set.
description: sweep-6 — finer varThreshold/history resolution around the sweep-5 plateau + sigma_x extension past 2.0
